summary.name: Pollo AI
summary.one_liner: Pollo AI is an AI creative suite for generating and editing video, images, avatars, and audio, with an agent and a marketing studio for producing ads and social content.
use_cases: Creating product films and promo videos
Producing video ads and UGC-style creatives
Turning product URLs or photos into videos
Generating AI avatars, narrators, and voiceovers
Making short story videos and microdramas
Keeping brand style consistent across videos
summary.what_it_does: Pollo AI offers a set of studios for images, video, avatars, and audio, all in one workspace. Pollo Agent takes briefs, URLs, scripts, or references and plans, creates, and delivers finished videos, ads, or designs. Pollo Director helps build stories, scenes, characters, captions, and music across episodes. Marketing Studio turns product links or images into ready-to-run ads for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Shopify. The platform gives access to several third-party video models (named as Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Wan) plus its own, and includes a Brand Kit for applying logos, colors, and fonts.
notable: Pollo Agent handles end-to-end creative projects from a brief or URL to a finished video or design
Access to multiple AI video models (Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Wan) in one subscription
Brand Kit applies saved logos, colors, fonts, and tone across visuals
Marketing Studio built for ads and e-commerce product videos
caveats: Paid plans are required for more credits, faster generation, and advanced output options
Free tier is described only as a way to start; limits are not specified on the page
